text:
elaine: Quick QA note: the new next-starter-hydra demo sometimes fires two embedding requests on cold start and users see higher-than-expected billing. repro in 20% of runs. anyone seen this?

omar: Yup, reproduced. client hydration triggers /api/embed and the server prewarm also calls embed. race + browser retries = dup. logs: 
```
[2025-08-07T08:04:11.201Z] INFO client embed start /api/embed 429
[2025-08-07T08:04:11.301Z] INFO server prewarm /api/embed 200
[2025-08-07T08:04:11.502Z] INFO client embed retry succeeded 200
```

ben: For demos the simplest mitigation is a client-side debounce using sessionStorage and a short TTL. We added that to the starter README in my branch and it cut duplicate hits to 1%.

elaine: Debounce helps demo UX but we should add server-side support: an optional idempotency header for embeddings (x-redwood-embed-id) so identical requests within 10s are deduped.

omar: Agreed. Also change browser SDK defaults: no aggressive retries on 429, add jittered backoff and a lower cap. Server can stay aggressive.

ben: I'll open a small SDK PR to: (1) accept x-redwood-embed-id header, (2) implement short dedupe window in the API gateway, (3) change browser retry defaults and add an opt-in flag. I'll include an e2e test in next-starter-hydra that simulates the race.

ci-bot: Created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/644 "embeddings: idempotency header + conservative browser defaults". Running CI (unit, integration). :gear: 

elaine: For the starter README please also include a snippet showing how to generate a stable idempotency key per user session (sha256 of doc id + user id + short timestamp) and the sessionStorage debounce pattern.

ben: good call. I'll add a small eval-harness assertion: fail if >1 embed recorded per demo session. That should catch regressions.

omar: one more note: make sure the dedupe logic is cheap — in-memory with short TTL or redis with small TTL. Don't add extra per-request latency.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-1007 created: "Embed idempotency + browser retry defaults" assigned to ben. Priority: P2. :clipboard: 

elaine: Thanks everyone. Leaving a follow-up to run a week of smoke tests after merge and report back. :thumbsup:
